data_source.description: Name or path of the CSV file.

data_content.description: Base64-encoded content of the CSV file.

has_header.description: The first row holds column names.

mode.description: How virtual users take rows: in order, at random, or each row once.

DataConfig.description: A CSV data source. Each virtual user takes rows according to mode.

variable_name.description: Name of the variable that receives the value.

selector.description:
What to read, by type: a JSON path, a regex, a header name, a cookie
name or a CSS selector.

attribute.description: HTML attribute to read, for type html.

type.description: Where to read the value from.

Extract.description: A value to capture from the response.

weight.description: Relative share of the virtual users.

RegionWeight.description: One cloud region's share of the virtual users.

url.description:
An absolute http(s) URL, a URL starting with ${variable}, or a path
starting with "/" that is appended to target.base_url.

Request.description: An HTTP request. The URL, body and header values may contain ${variable} references.

name.description: Scenario name, unique within the test.

weight.description: Relative chance that a virtual user runs this scenario.

think_time.description: Pause after each run of the scenario, e.g. "1s".

auto_handle_cookies.description: Keep cookies between the steps of a run.

data_config.description: CSV data whose columns fill ${column} variables.

Scenario.description: A sequence of steps that a virtual user runs.

duration.description: How long the stage lasts, e.g. "1m".

target.description: Number of virtual users at the end of the stage.

Stage.description: One stage of a staged load profile.

name.description: Step name, unique within the scenario.

extract.description: Values to capture from the response into ${variable_name}.

Step.description: One HTTP request in a scenario.

url.description: URL of the system under test, for reports. Requests go to the step URLs.

idle_timeout.description: How long an idle keep-alive connection stays open, e.g. "30s".

base_url.description:
Base URL that step URLs starting with "/" are appended to. An absolute
http(s) URL or a ${variable}, without a query string or fragment.

virtual_users.description:
Constant load: number of virtual users (at least 1). Use instead of
stages.

duration.description:
Constant load: how long the test runs, e.g. "5m". Leave it out to have
each virtual user run its scenario once.

ramp_up.description: Constant load: time to start all virtual users, e.g. "30s".

stages.description:
Staged load: each stage moves to its target number of virtual users
over its duration. Use instead of virtual_users, duration and ramp_up.

http_timeout.description: Timeout for each HTTP request, e.g. "30s".

scenarios.description: Scenarios that virtual users run, picked at random by weight.

region_config.description: Share of the virtual users per cloud region.

title: VoltTest test definition
description: A VoltTest load test: the load profile, the system under test and the scenarios that virtual users run.
